poses.caption: Stand in front of a stable chair with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and squat to touch the seat lightly, keeping your chest up and feet flat. Press through your feet to stand without relaxing fully onto the chair.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1593 SIT SQUAT. TWO equal SQUARE cells side by side WIDE2:1 landscape same full body person same camera scale SIDE-front three-quarter view facing RIGHT. Bodyweight NO weights. Simple stable gray armless CHAIR behind body LEFT, same chair position/seat height both cells, flat seat at knee height. Feet SHOULDER width toes slightly outward entire soles flat fixed floor a little in FRONT of chair, hands reaching forward shoulder height for balance BOTH arms straight soft elbows. LEFT START stand TALL directly in front chair seat without touching, knees/hips extended soft neutral spine. RIGHT BOTTOM sit hips BACK/DOWN to LIGHTLY TOUCH chair seat with buttocks, thighs roughly PARALLEL floor, knees track toes, chest up torso modest forward hip hinge LONG neutral back neck aligned. Feet and arms unchanged, do not relax slump onto chair or lift feet. Show actual seat beneath glutes and stable chair legs floor contact, not floating. Primary BOTH QUADRICEPS FRONT THIGHS RED ONLY: exposed lower front thigh fine red anatomy; upper covered FRONT thigh soft DIFFUSE red teaching tint on intact BLACK shorts. Glutes/hamstrings/calves grayscale. Smooth opaque cloth broad real folds NO radial stars fibers or muscle lobes through fabric. Fine detailed grayscale other exposed anatomy realistic hands fingers proportions. Complete opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK and BLACK MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH continuous hems seams no cutaway/transparency. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft shadows generous12percent margins head outstretched hands full chair feet inside EACH SQUARE uncropped. Equal male/female quality.
